title: Introduce duration-weighted cost mapper and invocation entropy sink for observability
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: We need better signal fidelity for long-running invocations and noisy token bursts. Existing token-level cost metrics weight every token equally which underrepresents work done in long-duration requests and de-emphasizes expensive kernel phases. This PR adds two complementary observability primitives: 1) a duration-weighted cost mapper that attributes cost to invocation phases proportional to elapsed time and kernel occupancy, enabling fairer per-route and per-callsite cost dashboards; 2) an invocation entropy sink that records shape/entropy sketches for prompt+response token distributions to make bursty or high-variance invocations discoverable and filterable in dashboards and alert rules. Summary of changes: - Add duration_weighted_cost calculation in serving/runtime/metrics, with optional per-invocation phase tagging. - Emit a new metric series invocation_entropy_sketch (compact quantile sketch as base64) and a low-cardinality entropy_score float. - Wire metric rollups into observability/ingest agent with new low-cost sampling to avoid cardinality explosion. - Dashboard: new panels in observability/dashboards/invocation-cost-lifecycle.json for phase-based cost stack and an entropy heatmap. - Alerts: add alert rule cost_weighted_slo_breach and entropy_spike_alert with tuned quiet windows. - E2E tests and unit tests for cost mapping and sketch serialization. Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration tests with ingest agent - [x] Dashboard panels and panel descriptions - [x] Alert rules and runbook entries - [x] Docs update in docs/observability/overview.md Changes are backwards compatible by default; duration-weighted cost is opt-in via agent config (duration_map.enabled=true). The entropy sink emits an aggregated sketch and a normalized score; raw token sampling is not introduced so we avoid high-cardinality traces. Commits summary: - 1a2b3c4: initial duration-weighted calculation and unit tests - 2b3c4d5: add entropy sketch type and serializer + fuzz tests - 3c4d5e6: wire metrics to ingest agent with sampling and backpressure guards - 4d5e6f7: dashboard JSON and alert rules - 5e6f7g8: docs and runbook updates; CI fixes Review conversation (condensed into single string): "Reviewer: Marcus Lee — please add a flag to gate the additional metric emission; we should default to disabled.
Author: added duration_map.enabled configuration and documented it.
Reviewer: Priya Suresh — are sketches safe for tenants that opt into Private? check KMS handling.
Author: sketches are stored in base64 within metrics payload, not persisted to object store; for Private we added an opt-out and log redaction.
Reviewer: Tom Nguyen — CI flake on serialization test, appears due to non-deterministic RNG seed.
Author: fixed by seeding and adding a deterministic test vector.
Approvals: Marcus Lee (approved), Priya Suresh (approved), Tom Nguyen (approved)."
files_changed: serving/runtime/metrics/duration_cost_mapper.go, serving/runtime/metrics/duration_cost_mapper_test.go, serving/runtime/entropy/sketch.go, serving/runtime/entropy/sketch_fuzz_test.go, ingest/agent/metrics_emitter.go, ingest/agent/config.go, observability/dashboards/invocation-cost-lifecycle.json, observability/dashboards/entropy-heatmap.json, observability/alerts/cost_weighted_slo_breach.yaml, observability/alerts/entropy_spike_alert.yaml, docs/observability/overview.md, docs/observability/runbooks/cost_weighted_slo.md, tests/e2e/observability/duration_cost_mapper_e2e_test.go, tests/integration/ingest_entropy_test.go, makefile: add e2e-observability target, ci/presubmit/checks.yaml
release_notes: Introduce an opt-in duration-weighted cost attribution and an invocation entropy sink. Adds dashboards and alerts; opt-in via agent config. Impact: improved cost attribution for long-running or high-variance invocations.
testing_notes: Unit tests for mapper and sketch serializer added. E2E test exercises metric emission through ingest agent into local prometheus mock. Manually validated dashboard rendering in staging and ran alert noise simulation against synthetic traffic. CI includes deterministic seeds for sketch tests.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: potential increase in emitted metrics leading to cost and cardinality growth. Mitigation: feature gated by default, low-cardinality normalization of sketch metadata, sample-and-aggregate policy at the ingest agent, and an opt-out for private installs. Added a runtime flag to throttle emission under backpressure.
notes_for_release_engineering: Feature is behind agent config flag duration_map.enabled=false by default. Enable in staging for 48h and monitor observability.ingest.metric_volume and observability.alert.rate. Dashboard files are ready for import to Grafana; provide migration script observability/tools/import_dashboards.sh.
